candidates.text: Although the criteria for determining the validity of state statutes affecting interstate commerce have been variously stated, the general rule that emerges can be phrased as follows
candidates.speaker: Stewart, for the Court
phrases: clearly excessive in relation to the putative local benefits

candidates.text: The nature of that burden is, constitutionally, more significant than its extent. For the Court has viewed with particular suspicion state statutes
candidates.speaker: Stewart, for the Court
phrases: requiring business operations to be performed in the home State that could more efficiently be performed elsewhere

candidates.text: While the order issued under the Arizona statute does not impose such rigidity on an entire industry, it does impose just such a straitjacket
candidates.speaker: Stewart, for the Court
phrases: impose just such a straitjacket on the appellee company

candidates.text: The appellant's order would forbid the company to pack its cantaloupes outside Arizona not for the purpose of keeping the reputation
candidates.speaker: Stewart, for the Court
phrases: reflected good will of the company's superior produce

notes: CourtListener phrase counts, Nov. 25, 2026. The balancing test dominates.
